summary: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the second of three cash dividend installments, as resolved by the April 28, 2026 shareholders' meeting and authorized by the Argentine Central Bank on May 15, 2026. The dividend totals ARS 23,003,675,041, equating to ARS 37.5441433549 per share (representing a nominal 3,754% of capital stock). The record date is July 1, 2026, with payment starting July 6, 2026, through Caja de Valores S.A. ADS holders receive payment via Bank of New York Mellon on potentially differing dates. Withholdings apply for Personal Property Tax and a 7% income tax. This is a routine capital return, not a special situation, with no deal mechanics or risk-arb angle.
